name: voice-orb
title: Voice orb
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A state-driven voice visual that pauses when motion is reduced.

meta.descriptionEs: Un visual de voz según el estado, que se detiene si se reduce el movimiento.

examples.title: Orbe de voz
examples.description: Un visual de voz según el estado, que se detiene si se reduce el movimiento.

api.name: state
api.description: idle, connecting, listening, thinking, speaking, or muted.

docs: Adapted from LocalMode UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Decorative motion stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
